decisions.reason: Premium customer support is a low-cost add-on that likely retains customers and has no indication of underperformance.
The version management tool addresses a niche need and may still be valuable, but its fit with core information services is unclear.
The data processing contract tool aligns with GDPR compliance demand in Germany and likely remains relevant.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a competitive service but was recently launched and may still be growing.
